card.name: Inside the word intravenous
card.fires_on: The final piece "avenous" of the word intravenous, when it is split after "intr". It appears in preparation and administration directions that mention IV lines, catheters, cannulas, fluids or containers.

modes.label: IV line or catheter
modes.description: The word completes intravenous before line, catheter or cannula in administration steps.

modes.label: IV fluids and sets
modes.description: The word completes intravenous before fluids, containers or administration sets in compatibility or preparation text.
